programme.desc: Tidligere Playboy-modell Jayme har funnet ut at sin Internett-kjæreste er feik og driver og kattefisker andre damer.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Marvin & Austin
programme.desc: Etter månedsvis med sexting med en flott modell, vil Marvin treffe ham i virkeligheten. Max og sangerinnen Chantal Claret kommer til unnsetning.

programme.title: Tatt på bar gjerning: Dobbeltliv: Noe nedrig foregår!
programme.desc: Quinton traff halvbroren Teran som voksen, og de knyttet seg raskt til hverandre. Uansett endret Terans oppførsel seg raskt.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Du ga meg godsakene!
programme.desc: I nesten tre år har Mariah bodd sammen med barnefaren og kjæresten. Tross at hun blir overøst av Bobbys kjærlighet.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Hvilken som helst gammel D gjør nytten
programme.desc: 20-årige Andrew har jobbet døgnet rundt for å stifte familie med dama, Nikki. Men nå har han begynt å mistenke at hun bedrar ham med yogalæreren.

programme.title: Just Tattoo Of Us: My Mam And Dad!
programme.desc: Charlottes kjæreste Josh er vert sammen med henne og hennes mor og far setter ekteskapet på prøve.

programme.title: Just Tattoo Of Us: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Tatovøren Charl hjelper Charlotte som vert. Vennene Saffron og Sheniya gir hverandre en beskjed.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: No Doubt
programme.desc: Blant annet spilles låtene: «Don't Speak», «Ex-Girlfriend», «Just A Girl», « Simple Kind of Life», « Sunday Morning» og «Trapped In A Box».

programme.title: MTV Unplugged: Stone Temple Pilots Unplugged
programme.desc: DOKUMENTAR. USA. 2021. Med Bob Dylan. Fra 7 år. Lengde: 1.13.

programme.title: Ink Master: Hjembyduellen
programme.desc: 15 tatovører fra hele verden kjemper for å representere hjembyene sine.

programme.title: Revenge Prank with DJ Pauly D & Vinny: The Prank with the Porcupine
programme.desc: Pauly D hjelper Samiah å ta havn på moren Chivon ved å invitere henne for å treffe sin 'nye kjæreste' og familien. De er tilfeldigvis kongelige.

programme.title: Revenge Prank with DJ Pauly D & Vinny: The Prank that Works Out
programme.desc: Vinny hjelper Andrea å ta hevn på mannen Seth for 16 års fleip. De arrangerer en time med personlig trener med en bortskjemt tenåring som klient.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: Foo Fighters
programme.desc: Foo Fighters spiller noen av sine største hits og forteller om inspirasjonen bak hver enkelt sang. Konserten inkluderer deres siste singel «Wheels».

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Messy Mike
programme.desc: Kjøttbollene snakker til dyr Jenni forklarer en sak hun brenner for Og Angelinas treff med Snooki og Deena er kjempeforsinket

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Mike mot verden
programme.desc: Røret henter endelig inn Mike Først i et legendarisk oppgjør med Angelina og så en følelsesmessig konfrontasjon med Jenni.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Kjøttkakeshowet
programme.desc: Mike håndterer fortsatt konsekvensene mellom Angelina og Jenni, og «spiller på begge sider». Mikes kone, Lauren.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Bassengfesten
programme.desc: Gjengen drar på ferie til San Diego. Mike egger og Angelina og Jenni går løs igjen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Romance And Revelations
programme.desc: Skrekkbrettet sjokkerer huset ved å avsløre et hemmelig stevnemøte. Romantikken ligger i luften for Grant, og slaget om Nads begynner.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Mistake!
programme.desc: Louis går løs på Chloe etter at hun har beklaget til Ant, så hun hopper i seng med Ant og kysser ham.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Carly Aquilino LXXVI
programme.desc: I en helt ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' tar Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Carly Aquilino over styringen med noen 'Sprø bilmodifiseringer'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Carly Aquilino LXXVII
programme.desc: I en splitter ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' stikker Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Carly Aquilino hodene sammen i 'Hodehammere'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Carly Aquilino LXXVIII
programme.desc: I en helt ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' prøver Rob, Steelo og Carly Aquilino å trå til med 'Tamme spark'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Angelina Pivarnick
programme.desc: I en helt ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal besøk av 'Jersey Shore's Angelina og tar seg en matbit med 'Diner-drankere'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Carly Aquilino LXXXII
programme.desc: I en helt ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' skaffer Rob, Steelo og Carly Aquilino seg litt mat til turen i 'Syklistdrivstoff'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Carly Aquilino LXXXIII
programme.desc: I en helt ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' tør Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Carly Aquilino å hoppe uti 'Mørkt farvann'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Carly Aquilino LXXXIV
programme.desc: I en splitter ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' deler Rob.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal LVII
programme.desc: I en splitter ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' blir Rob, Steelo og gjest Nina Agdal veldig fleksible når de utfører noen 'Utilsiktede spagater'.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: Don't Rock the Boat
programme.desc: Gjengen legger ut på sin første felles aktivitet, og danner uventede bånd. Senere får mødrene sin første time med livstreneren, Cheyenne Bryant.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: Never Have I Ever
programme.desc: Hele gjengen begynner å slappe av og finne nye venner, men så kommer en ny far. Leah vil invitere en spesiell til gjenforeningen.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: Welcome to Farrah-Dise
programme.desc: En utfordrende hinderløype gjør at et gjengmedlem må på sykehus. Trener Bryant tvinger OG-ene til å gjenoppleve sin stormende fortid.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Jenter er bare jenter
programme.desc: Gianni har alltid visst han var Alondras første, men forstår at han godt kan bli hennes siste da Tami avslører sannheten.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Du må løpe raskere enn som så, Ken
programme.desc: Lisa mistenker at samboer og huka-forretningspartner Joseph, kan være utro mot henne og hunden deres, Chloe.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: He Don't Even Have a Car
programme.desc: Tatt på fersk gjerning: Programleder Tami Roman hjelper mistenksomme elskere med å ta de utro partnerne på fersken.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: No Doubt
programme.desc: Blant annet spilles låtene: «Don't Speak», «Ex-Girlfriend», «Just A Girl», « Simple Kind of Life», « Sunday Morning» og «Trapped In A Box».

programme.title: Ink Master: OG-ene kontra Young Guns
programme.desc: I sesongens finale må de tre finalistene avsløre sine Master Canvas-tatoveringer.

programme.title: Ink Master: Shop Wars: Fire & Ice
programme.desc: I sesongpremieren er nå tatovering en lagsport når kunstnere fra ni av USAs beste sjapper ankommer for å kjempe om den enorme premien på 200 000 dollar og den aller første tittelen Master Shop.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Redemption: Coach Cleen
programme.desc: Tatovørene Ashley Velazquez og Tim Lees er tilbake for sjansen på oppreisning.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Jasmine & Mike
programme.desc: Jasmine og Mike har sendt hverandre meldinger i to år, og hun tror at han kan være den perfekte stefar for sønnen hennes.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Cassie & Steve
programme.desc: Cassie var på rask vei nedover da hun fikk en venneforespørsel fra rapperen Steve. Han ble det som skulle til for å snu livet til noe positivt. 2.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Aaliyah & Alicia
programme.desc: Aaliyah har alltid delt alle sine problemer med sin kjæreste Alicia.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: TV-vertene Nev Schulman og Max Joseph hjelper folk som har forelsket seg på nettet med å teste ektheten til deres elskedes identiteter.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: John & Kelsey
programme.desc: John er klar for å forlate Detroit, men en ting opptar ham: Kelsey. De har aldri pratet sammen annet enn på chat.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Nonsens og følsomhet
programme.desc: Joc vurderer å kutte ut skiva til Spice for å ikke sette ekteskapet på spill. Amy prøver å plukke opp smulene fra Bambi.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Ekte menn frykter ikke ansvar
programme.desc: Jecarah får hjelp av Tami til å undersøke om presset om å få barn skyver Ikenna vekk fra henne... eller om noen andre trekker ham nærmere.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Andi & Dade
programme.desc: Andi syntes Dade var kjekk og bladde til høyre. Med isteden for bare en hyggelig date eller engangsligg.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Har hun en helt annen leilighet?
programme.desc: I mer enn fire år har Gierra datet Shay, som jobber som klubbstifter. Gierra lengter etter å stifte familie med partneren.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Har noen bestilt Gary Beadle?
programme.desc: Ricci ber Kyle om en prat for å snakke om spenningen som ulmer, og Sophie og Jordan kommer til huset med ny og positiv energi til familien.

programme.title: The Challenge: All Stars: Stjerneknuste rivaler
programme.desc: De tre kjempende lagene uten en stjerne vurderer mer drastiske tiltak for å få en.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXIV
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' prøver Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Nina Agdal å finne balansen i et ordentlig 'Hengekøyehelvete'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXV
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob og Steelo besøk av Nina Agdal som avslører seg som scooter-ikon i 'Mopeddronninger'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXVI
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' drar Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal på banen for å bli 'Pickleballet'.

programme.desc: På programmet står blant annet låtene: «Name», «Slide», «Here is Gone», «Iris», «Black Balloon», «Big Machine», «What a Scene».

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker

programme.desc: Jon-Kristian er 10 år og har osteogenesis imperfecta.Bena hans kan veldig lett brekke, men han er flink til å trene musklene hele tiden for å få en sterkere kropp. Nå gjelder det å ikke brekke noe før teppet går opp på kulturhuset der han skal opptre.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: En flokk med seks heroiske valper som jobber som beredskapspersonell drar på redningsoppdrag med høy innsats for å beskytte samfunnet deres i Eventyrbukta, ved å bruke sine problemløsningsevner, kraftige kjøretøy og hunde-humor til å redde dagen.

programme.title: Kodetropp O
programme.desc: For å feire Frøken Os 100 år i tjeneste reiser agentene tilbake i tid for å se hennes siste sak som agent. Dessverre går det veldig galt og de ender opp med å gjøre fremtiden mye verre.

programme.title: Karla og Nordahl
programme.desc: Karla er 6 år og har en storebror som heter Nordahl. Hvorfor tenker Karla at han både er storebroren og lillebroren hennes? Vi får et innblikk i Karlas verden og hvordan det er for henne å ha storebror som er psykisk utviklingshemmet. Norsk dokumentar.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Fransk barneserie om den lille superkaninen Simon, som stadig får prøve nye ting. Med pappa og mammas hjelp klarer han alt, f.eks. begynne på skolen, gå til tannlegen, lære å sykle uten støttehjul og ta fly.

programme.title: Ricky Zoom
programme.desc: Satt i nåtiden med tilbakeblikk til 1990-tallet, dreier livet seg om avtroppende ungdomsskoleelev Sydney Reynolds som bor sammen med sin alenepappa, Max, og den progressive farmoren Judy: tre generasjoner under ett tak! Mens Sydney navigerer gjennom de uventede og til og med "katastrofale" utfordringene med å være en tidlig tenåring, blir Max desperat etter gi veiledning, perspektiv og støtte som hun trenger. Bestemor, full av både foreldrevisdom og kløkt, bruker sitt knivskarpe minne for å bevise at Maxs egne tenåringshyss ofte er parallelle med Sydneys.

programme.title: Bing!
programme.desc: Bing er tre år, og som treåringer flest energisk og nysgjerrig på verden. Bing bor sammen med Flopp i et hus i nærheten av en stor, fin park. Der leker Bing ofte med vennene sine. Det er mye å undersøke og lære når man er liten, og Flopp svarer gjerne på spørsmål og hjelper Bing på vei.

programme.title: Bing!
programme.desc: Flopp var ikke her, og jeg var lei meg, men vet du hva? Flopp kom hjem, akkurat som han sa. Det er lunsjtid! Sula og Emma har kommet hjem til Bing for å spise lunsj, men det finnes ingen gulrøtter, så Flopp må dra til butikken for å kjøpe noen. Bing savner virkelig Flopp, og Emma og Sula prøver å få ham i bedre humør. Men Bing klemmer fingeren i postkassa mens han leter etter Flopp, og når Emma prøver å ringe ham, oppdager de at Flopp har glemt mobilen hjemme. Hva skal Bing gjøre mens han venter på at Flopp kommer tilbake?

programme.desc: Orphaned when their parents are killed in an automobile accident, Ruby (16) and Rhett (11) are placed under the guardianship of longtime friends named Gary & Erin Glass. The successful and childless couple at first welcome and console the kids but their attitudes change with the passing of time. The rebellious Ruby begins to suspect that Erin is a junkie and Gary is a drug dealer in hock to the Mob. Also, the two may have murdered the kid's parents in order to access their estate.

But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.sub-title: One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind
programme.desc: Luck for Tony and Roger -- Jeannie proves to be one-of-a-kind.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sannheten om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer til slutt fram når de alle møtes på Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøk til LA og havner i en konfrontasjon med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi hvor hun beklager og innser at det er bare én ting som hindrer dem fra å bli venner igjen. Audrina starter å date en ny fyr for å gjøre Justin sjalu, men planen går feil.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møter sin gamle flamme Corey igjen og sjonglerer plutselig to gutter. Spencer tvinger Heidi til å sparke ut søsteren hennes Holly fra leiligheten.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina reiser til Cabo for Brody bursdag, men når Justin blir sjalu av Audrinas nye forhold, blir festen en slåsskamp. Spencer ydmyker Stephanie etter å funnet ut at hennes nye kjæreste er venn med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver å skape fred mellom Brody og Stephanie. Audrina ønsker å få ting til å fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke gi slipp på henne. Stephanie tviler på sin nye kjæreste etter at han bryter sitt løfte om å stå opp mot Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sitt eget sted, og håper at Justin vil flytte inn hos henne, men alle frykter at hun flytter av feil grunn. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med jobben, og blir tatt i å ha litt for mye moro.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reiser til New York og den nye gutten Jay stjeler oppmerksomheten hennes. Heidi er nedfor etter å ha fått sparken, og da Spencer snakker med Brent for å få jobben hennes tilbake, gjør han bare situasjonen verre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lar Heidis søster sove over hos seg. Justin ber Audrina med på tur for en romantisk helg, og Heidis frustrasjon med Spencer vokser etter at hun må tigge for å få jobben tilbake.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rykte hun hører: at Lauren har rotet med Justin. I mellomtiden prøver Holly å få Heidi bort fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøker å redde vennskapet med Lauren etter å ha anklaget henne for å rote med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøker bestemoren deres, som er lei av at de krangler.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney blir tilbudt drømmejobben i NYC og håper å få møte Jay der. Lauren blir nostalgisk da foreldrene selger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie ber Spencer om hjelp da hun ikke klarer å bestemme seg for hva hun skal gjøre med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer bekymringene til sine familier og stikker av til Mexico for å gifte seg. Whitney tar en sjanse på drømmejobben i New York City, og sier farvel til Lauren og sitt liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi møter på hverandre, og husker hvorfor de pleide å være venner. Spencer og Heidi har akkurat giftet seg da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin sjokkerer Audrina når han tar henne til Palm Springs for en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Når Heidi kommer til overraskelsesfesten på bursdagen til Lauren, gråter de to gamle vennene for vennskapet som har gått i oppløsning. Spencer starter en voldelig nevekamp når Cameron anklager ham for å ha plukket opp en bartender.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers sjarm fører Heidi hjem til Colorado, der gjenopptar hun kontakten med en gammel flamme. Lauren forteller Stephanie hva hun syns om at Heidi kom i bursdagsselskapet. Spencer snakker med Brody igjen etter en lang tids taushet.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Etter at Heidi tar Spencer på fersken på en nattklubb med bartenderen Stacie, krever hun at de skal gå i parterapi. Lauren setter ryktet sitt på spill når hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikantplass hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina forsøker å komme over Justin ved å kaste sitt blikk på Brody i stedet. Heidi sleper en motvillig Spencer til parterapi. Når Stephanie går i baret hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med å sparke henne.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Når jentene krasjer guttenes Hawaii tur, prøver Valeria å glemme Justin ved å flørte med Brordy. Heidis ekskjæreste, som er jomfru, kommer på besøk og Heidi håper at Spenser skal lære noe av eksens verdier.

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina fortviler når Brodys kjæreste konfronterer henne med Hawaii, og Brody gjør ingenting for å stoppe det. Heidi oppdager en tekstmelding fra Stacie til Spencer og drar til nattklubben for å konfrontere henne med det.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren er usikker på om hun skal gå i Heidis bryllup etter at Spencer endelig har bedt om unnskyldning. Brody nekter å risikere forholdet sitt til Jayde for å redde vennskapet med Audrina, og Stephanie konfronterer Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens siste episode må hun bestemme om hun er villig til å tilgi Spencer for å kunne stille opp for Heidi i hennes "prinsesse"-bryllup. Hele besetningen dukker opp og blir overrasket over en gjest ingen tenkte ville komme.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter krig når hun forsøker seg på Justin foran Audrina. Spencer og Heidi leter etter hus, og Spencer kjøper et hus uten Heidis godkjennelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Etter at Audrina ikke dukket opp, bestemmer Kristin seg for ikke å kjempe mot sine følelser for Justin. Heidi melder seg som barnevakt for naboen, men Spencer vil ikke ha noe med unger å gjøre.

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får smake på hvordan det er å ha et forhold til Justin når han ikke dukker opp på Brodys overraskelsesfest. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om når de skal starte familie, og Audrina dater Justins bestevenn.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror hun har temmet Justin, men kanskje er han fortsatt ikke over Audrina. Når Holly mister kontrollen på en tilstelning, er det Heidis jobb å få søsteren til å innrømme alkoholproblemet sitt.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin gjør seg kostbar med Kristin, men biter seg i halen. Hollys drikking fører til at Heidi og Stephanie må gripe inn. Brody og Jayde krangler slik at de må revurdere forholdet sitt.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin går på glør etter at Kristin og Audrina endelig møtes ansikt til ansikt. Alt Heidi ønsker seg til bursdag er en baby, men Spencer har helt andre planer.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin og Brody vurderer å date igjen, men når de støter på Jayde forstår de at tiden ikke er moden. Audrina og Justin møtes for å diskutere framtiden, men det ender ikke som hun håpet. Spencer går drastisk til verks mot Heidis babybesettelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin støter sammen med Jayde når hun kommer for å gjenerobre Brody. Heidi legger en plan for å bli gravid med eller uten Spencers samtykke, og Audrina må takle at Justin fortsatt har følelser for Kristin.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vil ikke ha Justin, men han gir henne ikke opp så lett. Audrina avslutter forholdet til Justin for godt. Brody får kalde føtter når Jayde vil flytte inn hos ham, og Spencer frykter at Heidi muligens kan være gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 114
programme.desc: Natalie har lenge drømt om en partner å dele hverdagen med. Nå har hun og Kevin endelig blitt sammen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 115
programme.desc: Julen er endelig her og Natalie har mye å gjøre. Huset skal ryddes, julegavene skal pakkes inn og all mat skal tilberedes.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 116
programme.desc: Den koseligste dagen i året er her: Julaften. Julia drar hjem til Milano og Björn for å kunne tilbringe hele dagen med sønnen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 117
programme.desc: Julen er endelig over og Natalie er fullstendig utslitt. Barnehagen er stengt og hun er opptatt med å prøve å underholde tre små jenter.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 118
programme.desc: Lina har lenge drømt om å putte fillers i leppene. Hun er ekstremt redd for smerte og er usikker på om hun er i stand til å takle det.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 119
programme.desc: Lina har fått nok av alle prekenene om hvordan en mor skal være og ikke være. En av hennes største interesser er skjønnhet, og hun får ofte høre om hvordan hun prioriterer feil.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 120
programme.desc: I den siste episoden er det på tide å starte 2017 og legge 2016 bak oss. Våre mødre ser tilbake på høydepunktene fra året som har gått.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 201
programme.desc: I den første episoden møter vi de nye mødrene LoveJoy med datteren Hailey, og Julia M med datteren Nanja.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 202
programme.desc: Julia M og Johan forteller om deres brokete bakgrunn og om hvorfor Johan havnet i fengsel. Natalie lurer på om hun skal bruke sparepengene sine på brystforstørrelse eller på en ny baby.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 203
programme.desc: Julia B prater om livet med Milan i et radiointervju. Lovejoy bader Hailey og forteller at hun ikke vil at Hailey skal ha en lignende barndom som hun selv hadde.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 204
programme.desc: Julia B vil se sommerfresh ut og bestemmer seg for å ta spraytan, men Milan synes ikke det er like gøy og gjør alt for å rømme derfra.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 205
programme.desc: Vi får bli med på Lovejoy Bäcklund og Rasmus rottejakt i huset. Julia Mindell og Johan skal signere en kontrakt for den nye leiligheten.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 206
programme.desc: Lina, Emil og Audrina besøker lekeland. Der får Lina prøve å kjøre bil, men det er vanskelig å holde oversikt over alle reglene.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 207
programme.desc: Julia M pakker før flyttingen og finner gamle kjærlighetsbrev som Johan skrev til henne fra fengselet.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 208
programme.desc: Julia M og Nanja besøker badehuset. Lina og Emil planlegger før flyttingen og lager et budsjett og handleliste for alt som trengs i den nye leiligheten.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 209
programme.desc: Joy og Rasmus diskuterer sexlivet og krangler i Haileys hytte. Natalie og Kevin er forlovet, men hvem var det egentlig som fridde?

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 210
programme.desc: Natalie og barna baker en kake til Ronjas 1 års-fest men blir avbrutt midt i bakingen når Bunny bestemmer seg for å parre seg. Hailey må holde mamma Joys hånd når hun skal ta tatovering.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 211
programme.desc: Natalie har begynt å jobbe nattevakt, så nå er det Kevin som får legge barna. Hvordan vil det gå? Både Joy og Rasmus synes det er vanskeligere å ta vare på partneren enn å ta vare på barnet sitt.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 212
programme.desc: Når Natalie og Kevin skal mekke på bilen, finner Kevin en romantisk overraskelse under panseret. Selv om Lina ikke er en fan av kjøkkenet, forsøker hun å lage grønnsaks-pannekaker til barna.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 213
programme.desc: Til tross for at Julia Bergman bare er 22 år, er hun redd for å bli gammel og hun forteller om sin barndom, kjærlighet og bokdrømmer.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 214
programme.desc: Kevin og barna har kollidert med en elg, og nå står de i garasjen og prøver å reparere bilen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 215
programme.desc: En lampe velter over Audrina mens hun sover, når Lina skal filme en videoblogg og Lina innser at hun ikke presterer like bra foran kameraet uten Audrina.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 216
programme.desc: Natalie og familien hennes skal på en hundeustilling. Men morgenkaoset hjemme fører til at de blir sene og glemmer å melde på hunden Rango.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 217
programme.desc: Johan har tre timers permisjon, og benytter anledningen til å ta med Julia M og Nanja til Torekällberget for å se på dyrene.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 218
programme.desc: Lina og Audrina går på babymassasje, men Audrina er ikke så interessert i å bli massert. Milan styrer båten til Helsingør når hele familien drar over til Danmark.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 219
